en: • The ever-evolving Gundam finally reaches its final form.
• Reproduce the set coloring with colored plastic and foil seal.
• Clear parts are used for the removable funnel part.
• Core fighter separation can be reproduced.
• The special rifle equipped with a gimmick changes into 3 forms.
• A special pedestal is included to display the funnel in the air.
